'''Wraith Five''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the fifth member of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Wraith Squadron]]. It was first held by [[Kell Tainer]], a demolitions expert, hand-to-hand combatant, and [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]].<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />

By [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the Wraiths were reformed by [[Wraith Leader (callsign)|Wraith Leader]] [[Garik Loran]] to prove the corrupt activities of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]. [[Wraith One]] [[Bhindi Drayson]] was assigned to lead the team, while the Wraith Five call sign was assigned to [[Jesmin Tainer]], an [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] and the daughter of Wraith Squadron original members Kell and [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer]].<ref name="MK" />
